questions.markdown: Identify all the stakeholders (including, individual, institutional, government as well as foreign) of the above STIP draft policy.
reviewNotes: Question continues from page 1 to page 2.

questions.markdown: Comment, in a sentence each, your opinions, on the above policy in terms of the perceptions of the stakeholders aligned with the following 4 parameters, which are relevant to providing technology-based solutions: (i) Content delivery mode, (ii) transformative potential, (iii) policy need space and (iv) policy practise space.

Write a short note on the concepts of "Outcome-based evolution space" commenting both on outcome positives and outcome negatives for the above policy. Provide 2 major policy recommendations to fill any gaps in the above policy which you can assess.

Based on the above information, write what can be 3 important policy goals for consideration under the following perspectives to provide technological support for strengthening agroforestry: (a) spatial dependency (b) time dependency (c) directionality of interlinks with other sectors. Mention two areas in which Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) initiatives can enhance agroforestry practices using technology?

Draw a 3 axes diagram to denote the useful (a) ORL, (b) SRL, (c) LRL and (d) the likely range of associated TRL which can provide technology policy objective to implement geospatial data services for the agroforestry sector.

Write the ascending order in which digital technologies can help to develop a strong Technology Acceptance Model of farmers for effective agroforestry implementation at a farm-forest unit level: Digitalisation, Internet of Things (IoT), Internet of Services (IoS), Cyber Physical Systems (CPS), AI. From the following table, match one policy deliverable (Column A) with one or more forms of technological operations (Column B) with a short explanation for your selection (Column C) provided below:

| Column (A) Policy deliverables | Column (B) Technology and operations | Column (C) Explanations for choice of matching (E.g. Choice 1 + Choice C; provide explanation for the same) |
|---|---|---|
| Development of Market Information Systems associated with geographical and ecological conditions | AI, Blockchain |  |
| Transparent and non-controversial OS | Remotely controlled irrigation, vehicles, farm machines and processing industry |  |
| PPP practices and services for ensuring farmer-market connectivity | Drone-based sensing |  |
| System to preserve certified planting material and germplasm | IoS, IoT |  |
| Market driven models suitable to different ecological conditions | Cryogenics |  |
